title: Command records, native execution, structured output, and RTK

baseline.note: Pinned S5.2 handoff; rustfmt-only evaluate.rs touch cleared format gate before S6 spawn code

outcome: E09.S6 lands the first production direct-process path. Only evaluator-created AuthorizedExecutionPlan reaches TokioExecutor. Durable pending command_execution records precede spawn; Gate/Deny/planned/unavailable write finals without PID and omit rejected resolution. Child env uses env_clear plus sealed non-sensitive keys; argv is literal; stdout/stderr stay independent; Unix process-group signal forward/escalate; native exits pass through; JSON capture is bounded one-document; session list/show/latest query operational records only. RTK is optional human postprocessing via capability-checked rtk pipe with byte-exact raw fallback; JSON never invokes RTK.
validation: PASS with pinned toolchain (rustc/cargo 1.96.0, moon 2.3.2): moon run takogami:build|test|lint|format-check; ontarch:sync|validate; panoply:gen-check|validate-substrate; git diff --check clean; no sh -c/bash -c spawn paths. Takogami tests: lib 116 + cli_smoke 17 + contracts_roundtrip 17 + execution_cli 7 + policy_cli 17 + resolution_cli 27 + session_cli 6 + session_store 12 = 219. Schema version 0.1.0 remains first persisted MVP baseline with required plan_digest and closed request/policy/resolution shapes.
decisions: Pending record durability is the commit point for process execution; pending write failure means no spawn.
Record coverage starts only after resolution + public Allow/Gate/Deny; resolution/contract failures stay envelope-only.
Gate/Deny records omit resolution so rejected argv never persists.
Tokio features process/signal/io-util/io-std/sync/time enabled; fs2 for advisory locks; libc for process-group kill.
RTK never replaces or re-runs the authorized child; separate stdout/stderr pipe invocations; raw fallback when larger/failed/unavailable/unsupported.
Historical S2–S5.2 session records left unchanged; secrets-scan historical finding preserved and excluded from S6 gates.

no_spawn: Gate/Deny/request Gate/Deny/policy contract/resolution failure/interactive class/pending-write failure → executor call count 0

handoff: E09.S7 receives stable direct executor, atomic command-record store, session queries, executed envelopes, and optional RTK semantics. Do not reopen AuthorizedExecutionPlan-only authorization, audit-before-execute, or silent schema changes. Graph/bin projections and full MVP fixture remain S7.
blockers: ontarch:secrets-scan detect reports a pre-existing age-secret-key in git history (commit a3a4978, 2026-06-24; redacted in HEAD, persists in blob) — not introduced by S6; human decision pending.
